scientific_question: Can the selected targeted-bilateral full-Cayley-LR attention chart close practical parity by adding the two independently diagnosed missing freedoms: terminal QK orbit capacity and radial/singular-value freedom?

diagnosis.qk_capacity: The terminal dense oracle reports pair rank 32 at 88.8% of the selected full QK orbit and identifies pair rank 64 as the first allocation above 90%.
diagnosis.radial_capacity: Cayley coordinates are exactly orthogonal and cannot change singular values; per-output-channel gain is the smallest already-tested non-LoRA radial freedom.
diagnosis.held_fixed: V pair rank 16 and c_proj pair rank 8 already recover approximately 90% of their selected full orbits; their ranks are not swept.

selection.primary: lowest common-loss horizontal dense-compute ratio over the four matched fixed evaluations
selection.instability: reject NaN, Inf, divergence, failed terminal evaluation, or MFU below 20%

prohibitions: no additive residual or LoRA-like branch
no MLP replacement in this factorial
